The canonical ternary yields true for an ownerless article without calling either fighter helper. Owned paths preserve the predicate result, fresh Item lookup and owner recheck. Fighter cleanup invokes hitlag exit before clearing the tracked article and damage/death callbacks.

Both table rows use this callback, whose behavior checks owner-dependent lifetime rather than animation completion. The fighter predicate checks its motion-state interval, and the item engine consumes a true animation callback result as a destruction request.
